settings_form.title: Application
settings_form.description: App-wide settings for tenancy, language, logging, security, request limits, the API and the database connection.

multi_tenant.label: Multi-tenant mode
multi_tenant.help: Serve several tenants from one installation. When off, every request acts as a single tenant.

tenant_header.label: Tenant header
tenant_header.help: Name of the request header that selects the tenant. Leave blank to use the default way of resolving it.

default_tenant.label: Default tenant
default_tenant.help: Tenant that every request acts as when multi-tenant mode is off. Ignored when it is on.

maintenance_mode.label: Maintenance mode
maintenance_mode.help: Show a maintenance page instead of the app. Admins, public pages and health checks stay reachable. Takes effect without a restart.

maintenance_message.label: Maintenance message
maintenance_message.help: Optional note shown on the maintenance page. Leave blank to show the standard text.

i18n_default_locale.label: Default language
i18n_default_locale.help: Language used when a visitor has not picked one. Must be one of the supported languages.

i18n_supported_locales.label: Supported languages
i18n_supported_locales.help: Language codes visitors can choose from, for example en or de.

i18n_cookie_name.label: Language cookie name
i18n_cookie_name.help: Name of the cookie that remembers a visitor's language.

public_base_url.label: Public site address
public_base_url.help: The site's public address, for example https://example.org. Used for canonical links and sharing previews. Leave blank to omit them.

log_level.label: Log level
log_level.help: How much the application writes to its log, for example INFO or WARNING.

log_format.label: Log format
log_format.help: Whether log lines are written as structured JSON or as plain text.

trusted_proxy.label: Trusted proxy
trusted_proxy.help: Proxy servers whose forwarded address and protocol headers are trusted: * for any, or a comma-separated list of IP addresses or ranges. Leave blank when there is no proxy.

session_cookie_secure.label: Secure session cookies
session_cookie_secure.help: Send session cookies over HTTPS only. Leave unset to turn it on everywhere except development and test environments.

login_redirect_url.label: Page after sign-in
login_redirect_url.help: Where users land after signing in. Must be a path on this site, such as /dashboard.

auth_provider.label: Authentication provider
auth_provider.help: Which sign-in module is active when several are installed, for example users or keycloak.

auth_public_paths.label: Public path prefixes
auth_public_paths.help: Path prefixes that can be opened without signing in. Use this only for routes no module covers.

native_link_prefixes.label: Full-page link prefixes
native_link_prefixes.help: Path prefixes whose links open as a normal page load instead of an in-app navigation, for example /docs/.

max_request_body_bytes.label: Maximum request size (bytes)
max_request_body_bytes.help: Default size limit for request bodies; bigger requests are refused. Routes with their own limit, such as file uploads, keep it. 0 removes only this default.

rate_limit_public.label: Anonymous rate limit
rate_limit_public.help: Requests allowed per visitor address on public routes, for example 120/minute. Leave blank or enter off to disable.

rate_limit_authenticated.label: Signed-in rate limit
rate_limit_authenticated.help: Optional request limit for signed-in users, in the same format. Counted per user, or per address when no user is known. Leave blank for no limit.

forwarded_host_allowlist.label: Allowed forwarded hosts
forwarded_host_allowlist.help: Host names a trusted proxy may pass on, such as example.com or *.example.com. Empty ignores the header. Needs a trusted proxy.

cors_allow_origins.label: Allowed origins
cors_allow_origins.help: Websites allowed to call the API from a browser. Empty allows none. * is not allowed while credentials are on.

cors_allow_credentials.label: Allow credentials
cors_allow_credentials.help: Let cross-origin requests send cookies and authorization headers.

cors_allow_methods.label: Allowed methods
cors_allow_methods.help: HTTP methods that cross-origin requests may use.

cors_allow_headers.label: Allowed request headers
cors_allow_headers.help: Request headers that cross-origin requests may send.

cors_expose_headers.label: Exposed response headers
cors_expose_headers.help: Response headers that browser scripts on other sites may read.

cors_max_age.label: Preflight cache time (seconds)
cors_max_age.help: How long browsers may cache the answer to a cross-origin check.

api_title.label: API title
api_title.help: Title shown in the generated API documentation.

api_version.label: API version
api_version.help: Version shown in the API documentation. Defaults to the application's own version.

api_description.label: API description
api_description.help: Short description shown in the API documentation.

openapi_public.label: Publish API schema
openapi_public.help: Serve the API schema to anyone outside development. It lists the documented API endpoints, so leave it off unless you want them public.

db_pool_size.label: Connection pool size
db_pool_size.help: Number of database connections kept open.

db_max_overflow.label: Extra connections
db_max_overflow.help: Additional connections allowed beyond the pool size during busy periods.

db_pool_pre_ping.label: Check connections before use
db_pool_pre_ping.help: Test each pooled connection before using it, so dropped connections are replaced.

db_pool_recycle.label: Connection lifetime (seconds)
db_pool_recycle.help: Connections older than this are replaced.

db_pool_timeout.label: Pool wait time (seconds)
db_pool_timeout.help: How long a request waits for a free connection before failing.

db_connect_timeout.label: Connect timeout (seconds)
db_connect_timeout.help: How long to wait for a new database connection to open. PostgreSQL only.

db_statement_timeout_ms.label: Statement timeout (milliseconds)
db_statement_timeout_ms.help: Cancel queries that run longer than this. Use 0 for no limit. PostgreSQL only.

db_idle_in_tx_timeout_ms.label: Idle transaction timeout (milliseconds)
db_idle_in_tx_timeout_ms.help: End sessions that sit idle inside a transaction for longer than this. Use 0 for no limit. PostgreSQL only.
